description: Represents the availability of a single communication channel for a specific contact. It combines the business-level capability of the channel with a contact-level eligibility check, so callers can decide how to reach a contact in one lookup. This is a computed, read-only resource (evaluated on request) and therefore has no uid, business_uid, or timestamps.

contact_uid.description: Unique identifier of the contact (client) this availability was evaluated for (e.g., "peu8ljecwqr5ok58").

channel.description: Identifier of the communication channel. Core channels are "email" and "sms"; installed third-party apps use their app code name (e.g., "facebook", "whatsapp", "instagram"). The set of possible values grows as new apps are installed, so treat this as an open string rather than a fixed enum.

available.description: Whether the contact can currently be reached on this channel. True only when both the business supports the channel and the contact is individually eligible.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason the channel is unavailable, or null when available (or when no specific reason is mapped). Possible values: "no_email" (contact has no email address), "email_blocked" (email is bounced/blocked and cannot receive), "no_phone" (contact has no mobile phone number), "opted_out" (contact opted out of transactional SMS), "no_active_session" (third-party channel has no active session for the contact), "app_not_installed" (business does not have the channel enabled/installed).
